scope: r111 instrumented full-process profile for element_elastic_cross_elliptic_6, sample 1, 2000 identical 100-step trajectories. This identifies current Ada cost locations; it is not C overhead attribution, release timing, guaranteed optimization gain, or coverage of other samples/models.
gprof_correction: Flat gprof attributes 108 samples (4.38%) to Evaluate_Block. Sized ELF ranges attribute only 26 (1.05%) there, 64 (2.59%) to Run_Primal and 18 (0.73%) to Line_Search. Raw mcount arcs have no direct incoming Run_Primal or Prepare_Gram_Layout record: their call counts are unavailable, not zero. Calls to Build_Gram and Factor_Values map to Run_Primal.

source_comparisons.finding: Mixed/elliptic Update rebuilds the combined Gram and numerical factor whenever Build_H is true. C retains the base factor and applies quadratic-state rank updates, then selects folded-cone rebuilding versus cone rank updates with a cached structural cost gate.

Ada prepares Count/Fill/Gram before the convergence certificate; C calls MakeHessian only if the certificate fails. This profile has no zero-iteration counter, so the avoidable fraction of setup is unknown.
Ada retains the single-row Gram traversal. C batches matching transpose sparsity rows into supernodes, sharing source-row/index visits.

C also copies Jmod per fold and rebuilds its numeric transpose. The cached Ada source-slot transpose already avoids rebuilding that mapping within the solve; the J copy itself is not a unique Ada defect.
